title: House Classic
notes: The reference 909 groove: rolling bass, a seventh stab, one pad

title: House Jackin
notes: Harder rim, the stab pushed, the same four kicks

title: House Lofi
notes: Dorian, softer hats, a longer room

title: House Linn
notes: Dry and tight, the shortest reverb in the pack

title: House Garage
notes: Shuffled hats, a suspended top

title: House Hardgroove
notes: Loud and forward, the least space

title: Deep Warm
notes: Ninths over a bass that walks root, fifth, flat seventh

title: Deep Dusk
notes: Later, darker, the clap on two only

title: Deep Rhodes
notes: An electric-piano voicing, wide

title: Deep Sub
notes: The bass is the arrangement

title: Deep Shuffle
notes: Maximum swing on the hats, straight everywhere else

title: Deep Night
notes: Quiet, long, unresolved

title: Minimal Tick
notes: Three kicks, one clap, one tick

title: Minimal Space
notes: Phrygian, and mostly silence

title: Minimal Clicks
notes: Dry to the point of rudeness

title: Minimal Dry
notes: No reverb worth the name

title: Minimal Pulse
notes: One slow filter and nothing else moves

title: Minimal Hypnotic
notes: Sixteen bars before anything repeats

title: Dub Chord
notes: The offbeat triad into a long delay - and it really is a chord now

title: Dub Deepspace
notes: Pentatonic, enormous, slow

title: Dub Basic Channel
notes: Hiss, a rimshot, and the chord

title: Dub Halftime
notes: Half the hits, twice the room

title: Dub Rimshot
notes: The snare is the only transient

title: Dub Echo
notes: Feedback high enough to be an instrument

title: Trance Classic
notes: Sixteenth offbeats and a triad pad

title: Trance Uplift
notes: The riser is a four-bar ramp on the pad's cutoff

title: Trance Acid
notes: Harmonic minor, and the one legitimate sample-and-hold

title: Trance Rolling
notes: The bass never leaves the floor

title: Trance Dark
notes: Phrygian - the flat second is a colour, never the bass

title: Trance Euphoric
notes: Major, bright, the widest pad
